{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the number of sites
print('Number of sites:', df['site'].nunique())

# Check if all sites have enough data to compute a rate
site_counts = df['site'].value_counts()
print('\nPatient count per site:')
print(site_counts)

# Cross-tabulate site and arm to check for balance
print('\nCross-tabulation of site and arm:')
print(pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['arm']))

# Cross-tabulate site and severity
print('\nCross-tabulation of site and severity:')
print(pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['severity']))

# Cross-tabulate site and age
print('\nMean age by site:')
print(df.groupby('site')['age'].mean().round(2))"}
